title: JustCrafting
description: Disables all vanilla advancements (except for crafting recipes)
body: # JustCrafting Disables all vanilla advancements, except those which unlock crafting recipes. ## Why enable crafting recipe advancements? Those who want to play with the `limitedCrafting` game rule and want to disable Vanilla advancements need a data pack which doesn't disable the crafting recipe advancements.
